items.title: ai.bithuman:essence2-android 0.5.15 发布, Android AAR for the bitHuman essence-2 avatar engine: drives an avatar bundle and composes teeth BORROWED from the donor bank rather than synthesizing them. A self-hosted session is metered at the published self-hosted rate (https://docs.bithuman.ai/guides/pricing); a credential the service rejects keeps rendering for a five-minute grace, then the session refuses, while a service that cannot be reached never stops a render. Bundles the engine's native library plus libonnxruntime.so and libc++_shared.so for arm64-v8a.

items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-liquibase 14.63.0 发布, Source of truth for the Dirigible system schema (DIRIGIBLE_*) running in SystemDB.
        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.
